column1: # boru Language Specification: boru:fn-util behaviour rows (frontier)
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# The eight BEHAVIOUR rows that lived here — compose, pipe, const, flip,
# partial, on (twice), memoize — GRADUATED 2026-09-08 (the thirty-fifth
# increment, the def-bound computed-fn model) and moved to
# lang/spec/module-fn.tsv. They refused as
#     def-bound computed fn apply (closure shape unknown — Stage 1)
# — the §5.4 / NUR101 family: a def-bound fn value the compile pass knew
# only as a Function carrier of no shape. Now the producing word's
# check-mode ReturnsFn claims the wrapper's arity, the check pass models
# the bound wrapper's WORD DISPATCH at the read (its arity of fixed tokens
# inside the statement), and the VM applies the wrapper on its own
# signatures. The refusal's note that "a lowered apply here returned 99 for
# 7" was the VM resolving the wrapper's label `const` through the live
# registry to the singleton-type maker — not the island it blamed.
# The CURRIED CHAIN followed 2026-09-08 (the thirty-sixth increment): the
# claim carries the RESULT's shape — every curry level returns a unary
# level — so `(c 10)` is a shaped Function carrier, `def c10` binds it, and
# `(c10 3)` models its own dispatch; the row is in lang/spec/module-fn.tsv.
# THE TWO ROWS LEFT were not that family at all: `FnUtil.flip 5` was refused
# by the strict-lane CHECK, as [uncalled_function] "call to 'flip' matched
# no signature", before compilation was reached.
# BOTH GRADUATED 2026-09-10 (the forty-ninth increment), and not by making
# the check admit the dispatch — the dispatch really did fail, and the
# program's specified result is that error. The site's own note ("NOT a
# RuntimeMirror … there is no call here to compile") named a true fact and
# drew the wrong conclusion: what a mirror needs is something that RAISES
# IDENTICALLY, not a call, and a terminal OpTrap is exactly that. A DEFINITE
# failure on the uncaught top line — every operand a plain concrete const the
# runtime match examines unchanged — now bakes the interpreter's own error
# into that trap, and the diagnostic becomes a mirror the pipeline compiles
# past. The rows live in lang/spec/module-fn.tsv.
# The interpreter remains the oracle that the vocabulary WORKS. This file
# now holds no compile-ledger rows.
